figurative_meaning_en: Wandering here and there; movement; activity; pacing
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চলৎফিরৎ দেখে মনে হয় সে খুব অস্থির।
বাড়িতে চলৎফিরৎ না করে কাজে মন দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: His constant movement makes him seem very restless.
Instead of pacing around the house, focus on your work.
note: This is a rhyming compound word (যুগ্মশব্দ) commonly used in spoken Bengali to describe physical activity or restlessness.
